Bug_Title: Equals method should be overridden in records containing array fields
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the record 'Person' which contains an array field 'names'. The default equals method compares array fields by reference, not by content, leading to incorrect equality checks.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by using the'showBug' method of the 'Person' class, which relies on the default equals method provided by the record. Since the 'names' field is an array, the default equals method compares the references of the arrays instead of their contents, causing the test cases to fail.
